declarations.name: LinearInputHistorySignature.mixed_second_reconstruction
declarations.exact_lean_statement:
theorem mixed_second_reconstruction {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    secondXY θ ℓ =
      Elastica.xCoord θ 0 ℓ * Elastica.yCoord θ 0 ℓ / 2 +
        LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ ∧
    secondYX θ ℓ =
      Elastica.xCoord θ 0 ℓ * Elastica.yCoord θ 0 ℓ / 2 -
        LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ

declarations.name: LinearInputHistorySignature.area_split_cross_term
declarations.exact_lean_statement:
theorem area_split_cross_term {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (a b : ℝ) :
    LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ b =
      LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ a + subarcArea θ a b +
      (Elastica.xCoord θ 0 a * (Elastica.yCoord θ 0 b - Elastica.yCoord θ 0 a) -
       Elastica.yCoord θ 0 a * (Elastica.xCoord θ 0 b - Elastica.xCoord θ 0 a)) / 2

declarations.name: LinearInputHistorySignature.two_inputs_determine_area
declarations.exact_lean_statement:
theorem two_inputs_determine_area {S : Type*} (base : S → ℝ)
    (angle : S → ℝ → ℝ) (length : S → ℝ) (p q : S)
    (u v : ℝ) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    (LinearInputObservation.energy base
        (fun z => LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angle z) (length z)) u p =
      LinearInputObservation.energy base
        (fun z => LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angle z) (length z)) u q ∧
     LinearInputObservation.energy base
        (fun z => LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angle z) (length z)) v p =
      LinearInputObservation.energy base
        (fun z => LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angle z) (length z)) v q) ↔
    base p = base q ∧
      LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angle p) (length p) =
      LinearInputAreaVariation.area (angle q) (length q)

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchForgetting.hidden_state_above_chord
declarations.exact_lean_statement:
theorem hidden_state_above_chord {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ)
    (p q r : S) (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hX : X q = (1 - t) * X p + t * X r)
    (hA : (1 - t) * A p + t * A r ≤ A q) (u : ℝ) :
    min (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u p)
        (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u r) ≤
      LinearInputObservation.energy A X u q

declarations.name: LinearInputBranchForgetting.minimum_forgets_hidden_state
declarations.exact_lean_statement:
theorem minimum_forgets_hidden_state {S : Type*} (A X : S → ℝ)
    (p q r : S) (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hX : X q = (1 - t) * X p + t * X r)
    (hA : (1 - t) * A p + t * A r ≤ A q) :
    (fun u => min (min (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u p)
        (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u r))
        (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u q)) =
      (fun u => min (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u p)
        (LinearInputObservation.energy A X u r))
